verdict.rationale: Base44's core interaction model is natural-language: users describe apps/designs and the AI builds them, with in-app AI chat, design previews, and instructions ('send instructions straight to AI'), corroborated by hands-on community reports of building full apps from a couple of prompts. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of NL command breadth/reliability and more detail on limits of what can be controlled purely via NL vs UI clicks.
